note: Clauses: the peer terminates and indicates failure; MUST silently discard Success (the Failure discard is a MAY). Termination: the EAP-Failure fails unless res.Err is ErrEAPFailure. Success discard: a later Success fails on !Discarded, Done, a non-zero MSK or Succeeded(). Positive: a completed peer concludes on the Success (Done false or Discarded fails).
